inputs.zvol_proxy: ZVOL = -0.971 x VXZ daily before 2023-04-19 (add. 47 long_panel.py); VXZ real from 2018-01-25 but re-priced on VIXM through 2019-01-31 in this study (see vxz_reprice), the vix_etp term-structure model on the real VIX3M/VIX6M from 2006-07-18, a synthetic VIX-only curve before (ts_synth); PULS = BIL in the panel. The VXZ 'mirror' is an identity before 2023-04-19

vxz_reprice.source: VIXM daily returns from daily.json (adjusted closes), beta ZVOL -0.971, VXZ +1.000
vxz_reprice.upstream: the add. 47 long panel (long_panel.py yh('VXZ') splice from 2018-01-25) and engines_ts_synth.json carry the same stale prints, so add. 47's harvester 2018 rests on them too; fix pending upstream, applied inside this study only

inputs.regime: VIX3M/VIX - 1 at the close; real VIX3M from 2006-07-17; synthetic curve (coefs in panel) before, used only for the 1995+ split

regime_counts.count_bases: 'with outcomes' = closes before 2026-11-05 (every table of outcomes); the other base adds the 11-05 close, which is one more close, episode, deep close and deep episode

rule.words: nine voters on Wilder RSI(SPY, w), w = 2..10, weighted 36/16/8/8/8/8/8/4/4: RSI < 25 -> ZVOL (unless RSI(UVXY,14) > 70 -> PULS); RSI > 80 -> VXZ; else PULS. ZVOL weight = sum of the weights of the voters with SPY RSI under 25. No term-structure input; no HYG condition in any saved version (add. 48).

harvester_number.what_it_is: monitor.py line 333: the symphony's last_percent_change from Composer's symphony-stats-meta, i.e. HARV's own day return; not a signal
harvester_number.gap_attribution: plausibly the 15:50 fills on 11-04 and 11-05 against the 16:00 closes (lpc +2.02 vs deposit-adjusted value +2.06 vs close-to-close model +2.38%); asserted from the mechanism, not measured against fill prints

model_vs_live.note: the engine path = the approved logic on Yahoo closes (the model); Composer's live weights differ on knife-edge and no-rebalance sessions, e.g. 10-30 engine ZVOL 0.60 vs live 0.52

context_1105.deep_verdict: the two real-era deep entries lost; the full record (29 entries, 23 modeled + 4 on -VXZ + 2 real) says the opposite, the deep-only counterfactual hurts on 2006+ and is noise on 2018+, and real-era ZVOL itself after deep closes is positive over 20 sessions: a watch item, 11-05 = observation 3, not a candidate

guard.note: no HYG condition in any saved HARV version (add. 48); the only guard is RSI(UVXY,14) > 70 -> PULS, which read 66.7 at the 11-05 close (not tripped). The add. 12 design (block ZVOL when HYG 1d < -1%) exists only in research/harv_sim.py; HYG was -0.31% on 11-05, so even that guard would not have fired.

harv_guard_sim.what: monthly returns of the add. 12 GUARD variant (block ZVOL when HYG 1d < -1%), offline reconstruction 2018-02..2023-04
harv_guard_sim.add12_numbers: BASE 2018-01..2023-04 +19.1%/yr, Sharpe 1.62, max DD 20.9% (a slow bleed, Feb-2018..Feb-2019); GUARD cuts the COVID crash from -5.5% to -1.5%, costs 1.5pp CAGR, never fired 2023+
